pick.headline: Students seize the US Embassy in Tehran
pick.summary: On 4 November 1979 Iranian students who followed Ayatollah Khomeini's line overran the US Embassy in Tehran and took its staff hostage.
pick.significance: Fifty-two Americans were held for 444 days. The crisis destroyed US-Iranian relations, dominated the last year of the Carter presidency, and the students later published embassy documents, many of them CIA papers reassembled from shreds.
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of 5 November 1979 gathered Iranian reportage under a single heading on the occupation: students occupying the embassy, staff taken hostage, the seizure of documents and the students' own statement.

alternates.headline: Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin assassinated
alternates.summary: On 4 November 1995 Yitzhak Rabin was shot dead after a peace rally in Tel Aviv by Yigal Amir, an Israeli opponent of the Oslo accords.
alternates.significance: The killing of the prime minister who had signed the Oslo agreements struck at the US-brokered peace process, and exposed a failure by the Shin Bet, which was responsible for his protection.
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia report of 6 November 1995 carried Palestinian coverage of an emergency meeting of the PA Council of Ministers to discuss the consequences of Rabin's assassination.
